Meta.title: Custom Kitchens, Wardrobes & Joinery in Bahrain
Meta.description: Global Island Kitchens W.L.L manufactures, supplies and installs kitchens, wardrobes and interior joinery in Bahrain. Showroom in Al-Hamalah, head office in Hamad Town.

Common.whatsappMessage: Hello Global Island Kitchens, I would like to ask about a project.

Hero.title: Kitchens, wardrobes and interior joinery,
Hero.intro: For over 11 years, Global Island Kitchens has designed, manufactured and installed cabinetry for homes, developers and commercial spaces across the Kingdom.

Products.title: Residential and commercial cabinetry, finished to order.
Products.intro: Custom sizes, shapes and finishes for homes, offices and commercial spaces.

woodenKitchens.name: Wooden kitchens
woodenKitchens.body: Modern fitted kitchens in EGGER boards or painted MDF.

wardrobes.name: Wardrobes
wardrobes.body: Hinged-door and sliding-door wardrobes, and glass-door closets.

bedroomFurniture.name: Bedroom furniture
bedroomFurniture.body: Bed sets with headboard panels, bedside units and dressing tables.

wallCladding.name: Wall cladding
wallCladding.body: Slatted and panel cladding, and panelled living spaces with LED accents.

Products.more: We also make laundry rooms, laminate doors with concealed hinges, Murphy beds and custom cabinets.

Materials.title: Two board families, chosen for how they look and last.
Materials.intro: We build with EGGER laminate and melamine-faced boards, and with MDF painted in the colour you choose.

egger.title: EGGER laminate & melamine
egger.body: Decorative boards from EGGER, the European panel manufacturer, in wood-grain, solid-colour and stone-look décors.

mdf.title: Painted MDF
mdf.body: Smooth MDF fronts and panels painted in the colour you choose, for a seamless, colour-matched finish.

Materials.swatchNote: Swatches are illustrations of finish families, not product photographs. See the real boards at our showroom.

Why.title: Designed, made and installed by one company.

experience.title: Over 11 years
experience.body: Manufacturing, supplying and installing cabinetry for homes and businesses in Bahrain.

factory.title: In-house production
factory.body: Our Hamad Town factory has a sliding panel saw, an edge-banding machine, a triple-axis boring station and a miter station.

scale.title: One villa or a whole building
scale.body: Specialists in bulk kitchen and wardrobe production and fixing for developers and contractors.

custom.title: Made to measure
custom.body: Custom sizes, shapes and finishes for homes, offices and commercial spaces.

Projects.title: Apartments, villas and commercial spaces across Bahrain.
Projects.intro: A selection from more than 20 projects, from fully furnished flats to cafe interiors.

Designers.title: A manufacturing partner for your projects.
Designers.body: We work alongside interior designers, architects, developers and contractors, from single rooms to complete residential buildings.

Showroom.title: See the boards, finishes and craft in person.

Consultation.title: Planning a kitchen, wardrobe or a whole project?
Consultation.body: Call or email us to arrange a consultation, or visit the showroom in Al-Hamalah.
